text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Macedonian President Kiro Gligorov left on Sunday on his first official visit to China. After visiting China Gligorov will visit the Unite States and meet president Clinton.

- Macedonian Foreign Minister Blagoja Handziski will lead a Macedonian delegation at the Balkan ministerial conference in Thessaloniki. A meeting between Handziski and his Greek counterpart Theodoros Pangalos is expected.
- Free trade agreement between Macedonia and Croatia goes into force at midnight on Monday.

- Shortage of funds is threatening to halt construction of railway track towards Bulgaria. The Macedonian government will renew its credit request to the European Investment Bank in Luxembourg and the EBRD in London for additional financing of the project. The final goal is to receive the already approved 30 million German mark credit line from the German government.
- Macedonian government to discuss on Monday a new law on the use of flags in the country. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
